      Methods in net.canarymod.api that return BoundingBox 
      Modifier and Type Method and Description
      BoundingBox BoundingBox.addCoordinates(double x, double y, double z)
      Adds the coordinates to the bounding box extending it if the point lies outside the current ranges.
      BoundingBox BoundingBox.contract(double x, double y, double z)
      Returns a bounding box inset by the specified vector (if negative numbers are given it will expand).
      BoundingBox BoundingBox.expand(double x, double y, double z)
      Returns a bounding box expanded by the specified vector (if negative numbers are given it will shrink).
      BoundingBox BoundingBox.offset(double x, double y, double z)
      Offsets the current bounding box by the specified coordinates.
      BoundingBox BoundingBox.union(BoundingBox boundingBox)

      double BoundingBox.calculateYOffset(BoundingBox other, double yOffset)
      if instance and the argument bounding boxes overlap in the X and Z dimensions, calculate the offset between them in the Y dimension.
      double BoundingBox.calculateZOffset(BoundingBox other, double zOffset)
      if instance and the argument bounding boxes overlap in the X and Y dimensions, calculate the offset between them in the Z dimension.
